info.title: Veer Control Plane API
info.summary: Versioned desired-state and operation API for Veer.
info.description: This baseline defines Veer's first-alpha HTTP, error, concurrency, idempotency, pagination, and evolution conventions. It is a transport contract, not evidence that every route is implemented.

externalDocs.description: HTTP API and resource evolution decision

servers.description: The deployment-selected TLS origin. The contract never embeds an environment hostname.

tags.name: Workspaces
tags.description: Administrative and policy boundaries. The schemas are a transport baseline; issue #17 owns the common resource implementation.

tags.name: Operations
tags.description: Asynchronous desired-state operation receipts and status.

get.description: Returns a deterministically ordered keyset page. Tokens are opaque, authenticated, scoped, and short lived; a sequence of pages is not a snapshot.

post.description: Atomically accepts desired state, generation 1, the idempotency result, required audit data, integrity metadata, and outbox work. The response does not claim provider convergence.

requestBody.description: Strict desired-state create payload. Unknown and server-owned fields are rejected.

get.description: Returns one workspace with a strong ETag derived from its opaque resource version.

put.description: Requires the current strong ETag. A semantic spec change advances generation once; metadata-only and replay writes do not.

requestBody.description: Strict complete replacement of caller-owned metadata and desired spec.

delete.description: Accepts a generation-fenced deletion intent. The asynchronous operation owns finalization and provider cleanup evidence.

put.description: Controller-only status write. It advances resourceVersion but never generation and cannot modify desired spec or metadata.

requestBody.description: Strict controller-owned status payload with no desired-state fields.

get.description: Returns the durable state of an accepted asynchronous operation without exposing provider response bodies.

BearerAuth.description: OIDC access token. Tokens are never stored in resources, logs, traces, errors, or audit payloads.

VeerRequestId.name: Veer-Request-Id
VeerRequestId.description: Optional opaque client correlation value. Invalid values are rejected; a server-generated value is used when absent and echoed on every response.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque retry identity scoped to principal, method, and canonical target. Reuse with a different normalized request returns 409.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag returned by the latest read. Absence returns 428 and a stale value returns 412.

WorkspaceId.name: workspaceId
WorkspaceId.description: Stable opaque workspace identifier. Display-name changes never alter it.

PageSize.name: pageSize
PageSize.description: Requested page size. The server defaults to 50 and caps the value at 100.

PageToken.name: pageToken
PageToken.description: Opaque authenticated keyset token bound to the original principal, scope, route, filter, and ordering. Tokens expire after 900 seconds.

ETag.description: Strong validator containing the opaque resource version.

Location.description: Relative path of the accepted operation.

RetryAfter.description: Bounded delta seconds before retry. Clients still apply jitter and an overall retry deadline.

WWWAuthenticate.description: Bearer challenge without token material or sensitive validation detail.

Deprecation.description: RFC 9745 structured-field date identifying when this operation became deprecated.

Sunset.description: RFC 8594 HTTP date after which the deprecated operation may become unavailable.

DeprecationLink.description: HTTPS or origin-relative RFC 3986 links to migration and optional sunset documentation.

StatusUpdated.description: Bounded receipt for a persisted controller status update.

example.message: The current generation is being reconciled.

MutationAccepted.description: Desired state was durably accepted; asynchronous convergence is not implied.

ValidationFailure.description: The request is syntactically or semantically invalid and caused no mutation.

AuthorizationDenied.description: The authenticated principal lacks the required action in the resolved scope.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist in the caller-visible scope.

example.title: Resource not found
example.detail: The resource does not exist in the caller-visible scope.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with a current invariant or reuses an idempotency key with a different request.

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match does not equal the current strong ETag.

example.title: Resource version is stale
example.detail: Reload the resource and retry with its current ETag.

PreconditionRequired.description: A required If-Match header is absent.

example.title: Mutation precondition required
example.detail: Supply the latest strong ETag in If-Match.

example.title: Request body is too large
example.detail: The encoded request body exceeds 262144 bytes.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: A request body is not application/json.

Throttled.description: The caller or scoped admission budget is temporarily exhausted.

InternalFailure.description: The request failed without exposing internal or provider details.

Unavailable.description: A system-wide safety or availability boundary temporarily prevents service.

example.title: Service temporarily unavailable
example.detail: A system-wide safety boundary temporarily prevents service.

RequestId.description: Opaque correlation value safe for bounded logs and response headers.

IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque caller-selected retry identity. It is not a credential and must not contain personal or secret data.

StrongETag.description: Quoted opaque strong entity tag; weak validators are rejected for mutation preconditions.

OpaqueId.description: Stable opaque identifier with no embedded tenant, provider, or personal information.

Timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp serialized with exactly millisecond precision.

Labels.description: Explicit bounded string map; this is the only free-form request object in the baseline.

ResourceMetadata.description: Server-owned identity and lifecycle metadata plus bounded caller labels.

generation.description: Starts at 1 and advances once per semantic desired-spec change only.

resourceVersion.description: Opaque version that changes on every persisted observable write and has no ordering semantics.

WritableMetadata.description: Caller-owned metadata; server identity and version fields are intentionally absent.

WorkspaceSpec.description: Minimal baseline desired state. Issue #17 owns the implemented common envelope and later resource issues own richer specs.

suspendReconciliation.description: Explicitly pauses new reconciliation admission without discarding durable intent.

Condition.description: Bounded machine-readable status condition with a safe human message.

message.description: Safe summary without credentials, raw provider bodies, or personal data.

WorkspaceStatus.description: Observed status written only by authorized controllers.

Workspace.description: Representative versioned resource used to make the HTTP conventions executable.

WorkspaceCreate.description: Strict create payload. Unknown fields and server-owned lifecycle fields are rejected.

WorkspaceReplace.description: Strict replacement payload. Concurrency is carried by If-Match, never by a writable resourceVersion field.

WorkspaceStatusWrite.description: Strict controller status payload. Desired spec and caller metadata are not writable through this route.

StatusReceipt.description: Bounded non-read response proving a controller status update was persisted.

WorkspaceList.description: A deterministic bounded page ordered by createdAt and stable id.

MutationReceipt.description: Bounded receipt returned for a durably accepted asynchronous mutation.

Operation.description: Durable state of one accepted asynchronous operation.

message.example: The current generation is being reconciled.
message.description: Safe summary without raw provider response data.

FieldViolation.description: Stable validation detail with a JSON Pointer and safe bounded message.

message.example: The field is not defined for v1alpha1.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with stable Veer extensions. Raw tokens, SQL, provider bodies, and secret-bearing values are prohibited.

detail.example: One request field is not accepted.

ValidationProblem.description: A 400 response with Veer's validation-failed problem identity.

AuthenticationProblem.description: A 401 response with Veer's authentication-required problem identity.

AuthorizationProblem.description: A 403 response with Veer's authorization-denied problem identity.

NotFoundProblem.description: A 404 response with Veer's not-found problem identity.

ConflictProblem.description: A 409 response carrying one of Veer's reviewed conflict identities.

IdempotencyConflictProblem.description: A 409 response for an idempotency key reused with different normalized intent.

title.const: Request conflicts with a prior mutation

UniquenessConflictProblem.description: A 409 response for a uniqueness invariant conflict.

LifecycleConflictProblem.description: A 409 response for a resource lifecycle transition conflict.

PolicyConflictProblem.description: A 409 response for an invariant conflict imposed by current policy state.

PreconditionFailedProblem.description: A 412 response with Veer's precondition-failed problem identity.

RequestTooLargeProblem.description: A 413 response with Veer's request-too-large problem identity.

UnsupportedMediaTypeProblem.description: A 415 response with Veer's unsupported-media-type problem identity.

PreconditionRequiredProblem.description: A 428 response with Veer's precondition-required problem identity.

ThrottledProblem.description: A 429 response with Veer's rate-limited problem identity.

InternalFailureProblem.description: A 500 response with Veer's internal-failure problem identity.

UnavailableProblem.description: A 503 response with Veer's unavailable problem identity.

ValidationFailure.description: A strict request object rejected a field that is not declared for this route version.

value.title: Request validation failed
value.detail: One request field is not accepted.

errors.message: The field is not defined for v1alpha1.

AuthenticationRequired.description: The request did not carry an acceptable bearer credential; no token detail is echoed.

value.title: Authentication required
value.detail: A valid bearer token is required.

AuthorizationDenied.description: The principal is authenticated but lacks the required action in a caller-visible scope.

value.title: Authorization denied
value.detail: The principal is not permitted to perform this action.

Conflict.summary: Idempotency key reused with different intent
Conflict.description: A scoped idempotency key is already bound to a different normalized request fingerprint.

value.title: Request conflicts with a prior mutation
value.detail: The idempotency key was already used with a different normalized request.

Throttled.description: The request crossed a bounded caller or resource admission budget and can be retried later.

value.title: Request rate limited
value.detail: The scoped admission budget is temporarily exhausted.

InternalFailure.description: An internal failure is reported without stack, SQL, provider, credential, or topology detail.

value.title: Internal failure
value.detail: The request could not be completed.
